text.tspan: MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

C12-001 · Prime regulated logic supply · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C13-001 · Probe plate signal · Documented probe kit; verify this fitted kit is a passive isolated contact. J31.4 is conditioned through comparator U24; establish JP7/JP8 population and safe pull-up/configuration from the exact P12 sheet. Leave J31.1 VMOT and J31.2 selected supply unused for a passive plate. Probe input maximum differs between board guides; no high-voltage capability is claimed.

C13-002 · Separate probe return · Documented probe kit; verify this fitted kit is a passive isolated contact. J31.4 is conditioned through comparator U24; establish JP7/JP8 population and safe pull-up/configuration from the exact P12 sheet. Leave J31.1 VMOT and J31.2 selected supply unused for a passive plate. Probe input maximum differs between board guides; no high-voltage capability is claimed.

Prime J35.6 is only a proposed PWM resource; verify firmware ownership.

C15-001 · Switched rail into pump branch fuse · Manual pp.19–20 names the air-pump interface but gives no pump model, connector pin map or load rating. Proposed DC pump load on Fan2 only after VFET voltage, startup/stall current, flyback suppression and connector rating are established. J20.1 is cutoff-switched VFET, J20.2 Q22 switched return; verify exact P12 firmware/resource assignment and reuse one VFET supply, not a second source tied to the same rail.

C15-002 · Fused pump supply · Manual pp.19–20 names the air-pump interface but gives no pump model, connector pin map or load rating. Proposed DC pump load on Fan2 only after VFET voltage, startup/stall current, flyback suppression and connector rating are established. J20.1 is cutoff-switched VFET, J20.2 Q22 switched return; verify exact P12 firmware/resource assignment and reuse one VFET supply, not a second source tied to the same rail.

C15-003 · Pump low-side switched return · Manual pp.19–20 names the air-pump interface but gives no pump model, connector pin map or load rating. C17-001 · Factory offline interface compatibility · Manual p.28 warns factory offline port is designed for its controller and must not connect other controllers. Keep factory offline controller/MPG disconnected from Prime until protocol, electrical levels and replacement firmware support are established. J30 debug UART is not an assumed factory pendant adapter.
